question: What is the meaning of internationally recognized product id in relation to product identification?
description: Internationally recognized product IDs are identification systems that are standardized and widely accepted across different countries and industries. They help ensure that products can be uniquely identified and tracked, regardless of where they are manufactured or sold. Examples of such systems include CAS Registry Numbers for chemicals and GLNs for companies. These IDs are used in the PCDS (Product Data Sheet) to provide a standardized way of referring to all reference standards and prevent irregular and lengthy inclusions of standards or excerpts directly when creating a PCDS using a template.
